candidates.title: Every failed Tibber poll logs an ERROR with traceback, and the outage latch counts two cycles per poll
candidates.claim: During a Tibber outage the integration emits one ERROR record per failed poll (6 over 5 polls; the rule expects 1 per transition) and counts 2 outage cycles per poll, so recovery logs 'recovered after 10 failed cycle(s)' after 5 failed polls.
candidates.mechanism: _tibber_fetch_failed's raise UpdateFailed is re-caught by _fetch_tibber_prices's own except Exception (coordinator.py:5465, re-entering the latch) and re-logged by _async_update_data's wrapper (coordinator.py:4460, exc_info=True).
candidates.metric_definition: Count of ERROR log records and outage-latch increments produced by 5 consecutive failed Tibber polls followed by 1 recovery, driven through the real update path with a fake session.

evidence.null_control: recovery half holds: exactly 1 INFO, 0 ERROR at recovery

perturbations.change: coordinator.py:5465 re-raise UpdateFailed instead of except Exception re-entry

candidates.title: All 13 service/config exception raise sites are untranslated; strings.json has no exceptions section

candidates.metric_definition: Count of raise sites of HomeAssistantError/ServiceValidationError carrying translation kwargs vs total, plus exceptions-section key count in strings.json/en.json.

evidence.value: 13 untranslated of 13 raise sites; 0 exceptions-section keys. Sites: __init__.py:413,417,427,558,605,611,656,722,765,788,832,846; coordinator.py:1370
